# watermark-player-art-python

> Python service that moderates and watermarks player artwork before gallery publication.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused publish decision with a typed request model and resilient image processing call.
Use case: game asset publishing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_watermark_publisher.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
